# Richmond Hill Golf Club

> Richmond Hill Golf Club is a fully public 18-hole parkland golf course at 8755 Bathurst Street in Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada.

Canonical website: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/

## Main pages

- Golf course: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/golf
- Golf academy and simulators: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/academy
- Tournaments and private events: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/events
- Dining and the 19th Hole Lounge: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/dining
- Practice facilities: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/practice-facilities
- Golf leagues: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/league
- Elite Prepaid Membership: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/elite-prepaid-membership
- Contact information: https://golfclub-seven.vercel.app/contact
